products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline. The headline is the per-band best-available product, selected from this feed by the publication generator rather than fixed as a constant: RYA-850 promoted the graded laboratory-gf pool to the PRIMARY reported value, and RYA-819 retired the earlier constructed anchor after showing its Magic-2013 correction wrong in both magnitude and shape. RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target.
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

irreducible_dispersion.basis: sigma_stat x sqrt(n_lines); valid because sigma_stat is the STANDARD ERROR of the mean — verified against the per-line layer on the VIS products that carry both (std/sqrt(n) reproduces the published stat_dex; the raw std does not)
irreducible_dispersion.reducible_by: PARTLY laboratory gf for NIR Fe I; a LARGE PART was non-convergent fits and has already been removed (RYA-1191)
irreducible_dispersion.note: 🔴 RYA-1191 RE-DERIVED THIS NOTE AND MOST OF IT WAS FALSE. It read 'gf-limited dispersion, IRREDUCIBLE under the current NIR line list ... KP ENGINE-A 1.315 at n=7 is the exception that proves it — CRIRES+ curated lab-gf is ~6x tighter at n=5'. That 1.315 is ONE NON-CONVERGENT FIT: line 9437.793 returned A = 10.988 on this holding and 4.539 on solar_iag — same line, same gf, 6.4 dex apart, red_chi2 246 and 152, with excluded_reason blank on both because constraint_gate asks only whether a fit was CONSTRAINED and its frac_rise_weaker is NaN. Rejected by pipeline.fit_validity, the dispersion is 0.144 at n=6 — not an exception, and INDISTINGUISHABLE from CRIRES+'s 0.138. The ~6x ratio was that one line. ⚠️ NOTE ALSO that solar_iag NIR ENGINE-A already read 0.177 here because its committed product had excluded the same line; the 7x gap between the two holdings was an exclusion difference, not a telluric one. WHAT SURVIVES, re-measured on guarded pools: the NIR many-line bars are still the widest (IAG 0.307 at n=22, KP 0.386 at n=23) against the few-line curated ones (CRIRES+ 0.138 at n=5, KP ENGINE-A 0.144 at n=6), so the dispersion still tracks gf QUALITY rather than line count and adding VALD3-grade NIR lines would still widen it. But it is NOT IRREDUCIBLE: it more than HALVED when non-convergent fits were removed (KP 1D-LTE 0.895 -> 0.386, IAG 1D-LTE 0.949 -> 0.307). ⚠️ dispersion_dex above is the PRE-GUARD value and is regenerated when the product is. Report-and-note per RYA-777.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline. The headline is the per-band best-available product, selected from this feed by the publication generator rather than fixed as a constant: RYA-850 promoted the graded laboratory-gf pool to the PRIMARY reported value, and RYA-819 retired the earlier constructed anchor after showing its Magic-2013 correction wrong in both magnitude and shape. RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target.
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

irreducible_dispersion.reducible_by: PARTLY laboratory gf for NIR Fe I; a LARGE PART was non-convergent fits and has already been removed (RYA-1191)
irreducible_dispersion.note: 🔴 RYA-1191 RE-DERIVED THIS NOTE AND MOST OF IT WAS FALSE. It read 'gf-limited dispersion, IRREDUCIBLE under the current NIR line list ... KP ENGINE-A 1.315 at n=7 is the exception that proves it — CRIRES+ curated lab-gf is ~6x tighter at n=5'. That 1.315 is ONE NON-CONVERGENT FIT: line 9437.793 returned A = 10.988 on this holding and 4.539 on solar_iag — same line, same gf, 6.4 dex apart, red_chi2 246 and 152, with excluded_reason blank on both because constraint_gate asks only whether a fit was CONSTRAINED and its frac_rise_weaker is NaN. Rejected by pipeline.fit_validity, the dispersion is 0.144 at n=6 — not an exception, and INDISTINGUISHABLE from CRIRES+'s 0.138. The ~6x ratio was that one line. ⚠️ NOTE ALSO that solar_iag NIR ENGINE-A already read 0.177 here because its committed product had excluded the same line; the 7x gap between the two holdings was an exclusion difference, not a telluric one. WHAT SURVIVES, re-measured on guarded pools: the NIR many-line bars are still the widest (IAG 0.307 at n=22, KP 0.386 at n=23) against the few-line curated ones (CRIRES+ 0.138 at n=5, KP ENGINE-A 0.144 at n=6), so the dispersion still tracks gf QUALITY rather than line count and adding VALD3-grade NIR lines would still widen it. But it is NOT IRREDUCIBLE: it more than HALVED when non-convergent fits were removed (KP 1D-LTE 0.895 -> 0.386, IAG 1D-LTE 0.949 -> 0.307). ⚠️ dispersion_dex above is the PRE-GUARD value and is regenerated when the product is. Report-and-note per RYA-777.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline. The headline is the per-band best-available product, selected from this feed by the publication generator rather than fixed as a constant: RYA-850 promoted the graded laboratory-gf pool to the PRIMARY reported value, and RYA-819 retired the earlier constructed anchor after showing its Magic-2013 correction wrong in both magnitude and shape. RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target.
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

irreducible_dispersion.reducible_by: PARTLY laboratory gf for NIR Fe I; a LARGE PART was non-convergent fits and has already been removed (RYA-1191)
irreducible_dispersion.note: 🔴 RYA-1191 RE-DERIVED THIS NOTE AND MOST OF IT WAS FALSE. It read 'gf-limited dispersion, IRREDUCIBLE under the current NIR line list ... KP ENGINE-A 1.315 at n=7 is the exception that proves it — CRIRES+ curated lab-gf is ~6x tighter at n=5'. That 1.315 is ONE NON-CONVERGENT FIT: line 9437.793 returned A = 10.988 on this holding and 4.539 on solar_iag — same line, same gf, 6.4 dex apart, red_chi2 246 and 152, with excluded_reason blank on both because constraint_gate asks only whether a fit was CONSTRAINED and its frac_rise_weaker is NaN. Rejected by pipeline.fit_validity, the dispersion is 0.144 at n=6 — not an exception, and INDISTINGUISHABLE from CRIRES+'s 0.138. The ~6x ratio was that one line. ⚠️ NOTE ALSO that solar_iag NIR ENGINE-A already read 0.177 here because its committed product had excluded the same line; the 7x gap between the two holdings was an exclusion difference, not a telluric one. WHAT SURVIVES, re-measured on guarded pools: the NIR many-line bars are still the widest (IAG 0.307 at n=22, KP 0.386 at n=23) against the few-line curated ones (CRIRES+ 0.138 at n=5, KP ENGINE-A 0.144 at n=6), so the dispersion still tracks gf QUALITY rather than line count and adding VALD3-grade NIR lines would still widen it. But it is NOT IRREDUCIBLE: it more than HALVED when non-convergent fits were removed (KP 1D-LTE 0.895 -> 0.386, IAG 1D-LTE 0.949 -> 0.307). ⚠️ dispersion_dex above is the PRE-GUARD value and is regenerated when the product is. Report-and-note per RYA-777.

That 1.315 is ONE NON-CONVERGENT FIT: line 9437.793 returned A = 10.988 on this holding and 4.539 on solar_iag — same line, same gf, 6.4 dex apart, red_chi2 246 and 152, with excluded_reason blank on both because constraint_gate asks only whether a fit was CONSTRAINED and its frac_rise_weaker is NaN. Rejected by pipeline.fit_validity, the dispersion is 0.144 at n=6 — not an exception, and INDISTINGUISHABLE from CRIRES+'s 0.138. The ~6x ratio was that one line. ⚠️ NOTE ALSO that solar_iag NIR ENGINE-A already read 0.177 here because its committed product had excluded the same line; the 7x gap between the two holdings was an exclusion difference, not a telluric one. WHAT SURVIVES, re-measured on guarded pools: the NIR many-line bars are still the widest (IAG 0.307 at n=22, KP 0.386 at n=23) against the few-line curated ones (CRIRES+ 0.138 at n=5, KP ENGINE-A 0.144 at n=6), so the dispersion still tracks gf QUALITY rather than line count and adding VALD3-grade NIR lines would still widen it. But it is NOT IRREDUCIBLE: it more than HALVED when non-convergent fits were removed (KP 1D-LTE 0.895 -> 0.386, IAG 1D-LTE 0.949 -> 0.307). ⚠️ dispersion_dex above is the PRE-GUARD value and is regenerated when the product is. Report-and-note per RYA-777.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline. The headline is the per-band best-available product, selected from this feed by the publication generator rather than fixed as a constant: RYA-850 promoted the graded laboratory-gf pool to the PRIMARY reported value, and RYA-819 retired the earlier constructed anchor after showing its Magic-2013 correction wrong in both magnitude and shape. RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target.
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

That 1.315 is ONE NON-CONVERGENT FIT: line 9437.793 returned A = 10.988 on this holding and 4.539 on solar_iag — same line, same gf, 6.4 dex apart, red_chi2 246 and 152, with excluded_reason blank on both because constraint_gate asks only whether a fit was CONSTRAINED and its frac_rise_weaker is NaN. Rejected by pipeline.fit_validity, the dispersion is 0.144 at n=6 — not an exception, and INDISTINGUISHABLE from CRIRES+'s 0.138. The ~6x ratio was that one line. ⚠️ NOTE ALSO that solar_iag NIR ENGINE-A already read 0.177 here because its committed product had excluded the same line; the 7x gap between the two holdings was an exclusion difference, not a telluric one. WHAT SURVIVES, re-measured on guarded pools: the NIR many-line bars are still the widest (IAG 0.307 at n=22, KP 0.386 at n=23) against the few-line curated ones (CRIRES+ 0.138 at n=5, KP ENGINE-A 0.144 at n=6), so the dispersion still tracks gf QUALITY rather than line count and adding VALD3-grade NIR lines would still widen it. But it is NOT IRREDUCIBLE: it more than HALVED when non-convergent fits were removed (KP 1D-LTE 0.895 -> 0.386, IAG 1D-LTE 0.949 -> 0.307). ⚠️ dispersion_dex above is the PRE-GUARD value and is regenerated when the product is. Report-and-note per RYA-777.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline. The headline is the per-band best-available product, selected from this feed by the publication generator rather than fixed as a constant: RYA-850 promoted the graded laboratory-gf pool to the PRIMARY reported value, and RYA-819 retired the earlier constructed anchor after showing its Magic-2013 correction wrong in both magnitude and shape. RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target.
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline. The headline is the per-band best-available product, selected from this feed by the publication generator rather than fixed as a constant: RYA-850 promoted the graded laboratory-gf pool to the PRIMARY reported value, and RYA-819 retired the earlier constructed anchor after showing its Magic-2013 correction wrong in both magnitude and shape. RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target.
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline. The headline is the per-band best-available product, selected from this feed by the publication generator rather than fixed as a constant: RYA-850 promoted the graded laboratory-gf pool to the PRIMARY reported value, and RYA-819 retired the earlier constructed anchor after showing its Magic-2013 correction wrong in both magnitude and shape. RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target.
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline. The headline is the per-band best-available product, selected from this feed by the publication generator rather than fixed as a constant: RYA-850 promoted the graded laboratory-gf pool to the PRIMARY reported value, and RYA-819 retired the earlier constructed anchor after showing its Magic-2013 correction wrong in both magnitude and shape. RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target.
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

products.aggregate_collision_note: Published A is the MEDIAN of the per-line abundances (nlte_effect.json: aggregator=median). On this holding the <3D>-LTE and <3D>-NLTE medians coincide at 7.552 while their MEANS differ by +0.0267 dex and the NLTE departure moves 66 of 67 lines. The pair is NOT byte-identical and the NLTE leg is NOT unwired: the same code path on kpno_kurucz2005 gives 7.541 vs 7.562. Genuine median coincidence, kept as two products (RYA-1178 Part 0).

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline. components.name: pseudo_continuum
components.source: RYA-846 sigma_delta, measured at this band's product lines: Kitt Peak (Kurucz/Brault) vs Wallace+2011 (NSO), two independent reductions, deconfounded from Wallace's own internal scatter. components.name: continuum
components.source: the per-line continuum fit carries no evidence to price -- continuum_method, continuum_ref and continuum_level are empty on every line in this pool -- and the band-level continuum PLACEMENT uncertainty is measured by RYA-846 and charged once, on pseudo_continuum.

evidence.why_withdrawn: it was the OBSERVED SPREAD BETWEEN THE TWO HOLDINGS, which prices each product from its sibling's answer, and it exceeded RYA-846's real measurement -- a bound where a measurement exists (Ryan, 2026-09-19: do not bound-fudge)

RYA-1133 recorded this as blocked on Fe II near-UV having no *_lines.csv; RYA-908 emitted them the same day and 14 are in the tree, so it is RUNNABLE, and it would refine rather than unblock -- the term is measured now.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline. The headline is the per-band best-available product, selected from this feed by the publication generator rather than fixed as a constant: RYA-850 promoted the graded laboratory-gf pool to the PRIMARY reported value, and RYA-819 retired the earlier constructed anchor after showing its Magic-2013 correction wrong in both magnitude and shape. RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target.
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1213: the two new near-UV Fe I Reference Gerber-LTE rows landed after the previous annotation pass. Every near-UV product must state the band's residual opacity deficit or it reads as a converged answer.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline. The headline is the per-band best-available product, selected from this feed by the publication generator rather than fixed as a constant: RYA-850 promoted the graded laboratory-gf pool to the PRIMARY reported value, and RYA-819 retired the earlier constructed anchor after showing its Magic-2013 correction wrong in both magnitude and shape. RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target.
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline. The headline is the per-band best-available product, selected from this feed by the publication generator rather than fixed as a constant: RYA-850 promoted the graded laboratory-gf pool to the PRIMARY reported value, and RYA-819 retired the earlier constructed anchor after showing its Magic-2013 correction wrong in both magnitude and shape. RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target.
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

Error-bar forest

How to read this forest. Each measured row is a separate abundance product for an instrument, holding, line pool and treatment; engines are never averaged together. Solid bars show statistical uncertainty from the line measurements; wireframes show systematic uncertainty from the product’s adopted error budget, which does not average away with more lines. Green and gold regions mark the Asplund and Lodders literature values and uncertainties, not pass/fail gates. Grades describe the line pool’s provenance and selection, not the quality of an engine. Reddish-orange mean-3D / Frankenstein rows are experimental and not adopted. Unmeasured model rows remain N/A.

Grades and model labels
  • Reference Grade. An externally published reference line pool, using that reference’s line selection and oscillator strengths; the current Fe reference products use AGSS21. This is a provenance category, not a promise that every line has an individual primary-laboratory uncertainty.
  • Codex Grade. The vetted Codex pool of primary-laboratory oscillator strengths, restricted to lines at or below the adopted feature-depth gate.
  • Deep Grade. The corresponding laboratory-data pool above that depth gate. These stronger lines extend coverage but require particular care with saturation and blends.

1D-LTE uses a one-dimensional atmosphere with atomic populations in local thermodynamic equilibrium. 1D-NLTE allows departures from that equilibrium; the named implementation supplies the correction or synthesis treatment.

3D-NLTE (Amarsi) includes three-dimensional atmospheric structure and non-LTE line formation; these products apply the published Amarsi correction grid to a 1D baseline.

Mean-3D / Frankenstein combines a spatially and temporally averaged 3D atmosphere with the Gerber synthesis route. Averaging removes the full 3D fluctuations and velocity field; this experimental hybrid is not a full 3D calculation or an adopted engine.

Synthesis fits the spectral line profile. EW infers abundance from a line’s integrated absorption (equivalent width). See Methodology for the full model, line-selection and uncertainty procedures.

Solar iron context

Fe I supplies the bulk of the neutral-iron line statistics used for the Solar abundance reference. Separate instruments, line pools and treatments test the stability of that reference; their differences remain visible.

Near-UV opacity — report and noted

Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline. The headline is the per-band best-available product, selected from this feed by the publication generator rather than fixed as a constant: RYA-850 promoted the graded laboratory-gf pool to the PRIMARY reported value, and RYA-819 retired the earlier constructed anchor after showing its Magic-2013 correction wrong in both magnitude and shape. RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target.

Frankenstein — experimental, pending the Bride

4 experimental products remain available in the Fe I product values and downloads.

RYA-1197 Part A: the Frankenstein mean-<3D> route is HELD FROM HEADLINE publication until the Bride validates it. It inflates A(Fe) by roughly +0.10 dex against the 1D siblings and exists on VIS/KP only, so it is not a comparable measurement of the same quantity. It stays in the feed deliberately: the LTE/NLTE mean-3D PAIR is the NLTE differential on ONE atmosphere (RYA-542), which is the diagnostic it is for. Not a headline value.

This product is ALSO a reference-set replication anchor, not a xi-varying measurement of ours — N/A on either ground (RYA-1185).
